area: game feature: data-driven victory cinematic loaded from a shipped .kpath via Keystone CameraPathLibrary

find.report_claim: keystone commit 7a1345e added .kpath documents (camera_path_to_dict/from_dict, CAMERA_PATH_SCHEMA 1) and CameraPathLibrary: an atomic, name-validated, trash-backed directory of authored camera paths; the library entry model is documented at ADR level but has no game consumer
find.live_evidence: shooter's victory screen still showed the player's frozen first-person eye while the CAMPAIGN COMPLETE banner drew over it, and the only cinematic in the game (death) was authored in code, so no path was ever stored as data
find.consumer_evidence: the campaign_clear capture route produced identical camera metadata before and after the wave: fov 75, position [0.0, 1.62, 8.0], yaw 0, pitch 0

read: keystone/camera_path.py new document functions and CAMERA_PATH_SCHEMA
keystone/camera_path_library.py save/load/entry/trash and the atomic write policy
shooter/game.py campaign-clear block, camera precedence and data-loading convention
killed: authoring the victory path in code like the death cinematic: the new library exists precisely so a path is DATA that can be re-authored without a code change and validated by name
failing the victory screen when the document is missing or corrupt: a cinematic is presentation, so the game must fall back to first person and record why
looping the victory path behind the debrief: a one-shot that clamps on its last key keeps the final frame stable
analyze.survivor: ship the path as shooter/data/campaign_clear.kpath, load it through CameraPathLibrary at campaign seal, drive the camera while keeping the snapshot untouched, and fall back with a recorded error if the document cannot load

fix.shooter: adds shooter/data/campaign_clear.kpath (schema 1, 4 keys at 0.0/1.2/2.4/3.5 s, one-shot, orbit radius 7.2->5.0 m, height 3.3->1.9 m, fov 62->52) authored through CameraPathLibrary.save; game.py loads it in _start_campaign_clear_camera on campaign seal, drives position/yaw/pitch/fov_y from CameraPathPlayer, exposes campaign_camera_report, falls back to first person with an error report on any KeyError/OSError/TypeError/ValueError, and clears it on build_scene; tests/test_campaign_camera_path.py (6 tests) covers the document shape, load, engagement, pose following, one-shot clamping, absence of leakage into the snapshot, graceful fallback and rebuild clearing
